testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.migration.DeploymentLeaseMigrationTests

testcase.name: the undo script drops exactly what V30 added and puts the old status list back()
every deployment draws the next activation number, in order, and it is unique()
a lease is all or nothing, names its deployment when it is a publish, and its token is never ahead of the counter()
the undo script refuses while a deployment is ROLLING_BACK or a scope lease is held, and changes nothing()
the backfill of the previous release accepts only a deployment of the same project, and active_seq starts from the served deployment()
ROLLING_BACK is a valid status, ROLLBACK_FAILED and ROLLBACK_OFFLINE are not - they are events()
a new site starts free, at version 0, with no active operation()
V30 runs after V29 and is applied once()
